title: Commemorative coin ki do values
instruction: Coin cards ko use aur value partners se jodo. Circulation, collector demand aur legal payment value mix mat karo.

pieces.label: Circulation commemorative coins
pieces.right: Yeh circulation mein release hote hain aur ordinary coins ki tarah usable hain.
pieces.wrong: Sirf collector sets mein rakhne se circulation mein release hone wala feature chhoot jaayega.

pieces.label: Collector commemorative coins
pieces.right: Government Mint proof ya UNC sets mein bechta hai; everyday transactions mein use rare hai.
pieces.wrong: Rare everyday use ko routine circulation banaane se dono categories ka farq mit jaayega.

pieces.label: ₹100 silver coin: payment value
pieces.right: Book ke example mein coin legally ₹100 payment kar sakta hai. Silver ya collector interest face value automatically nahi badhaata.
pieces.wrong: Collector price ko payment value banaane se ₹100 face value ka legal role galat ho jaayega.

pieces.label: ₹100 silver coin: collector price
pieces.right: Collector isi coin ke liye several thousand rupees de sakta hai; market price aur legal payment value alag hain.
pieces.wrong: Collector price zaroor ₹100 maanoge toh premium-price example explain nahi hoga.

win: Ek coin: circulation status alag, legal face value alag, collector price alag.
